    assert vowels_count("abcde") == 2      # a, e

    # Trailing y / Y
    assert vowels_count("busy") == 1       # u + y
    assert vowels_count("Y") == 1          # Y alone
    assert vowels_count("y") == 1
    assert vowels_count("yaml") == 1       # y not at end â not counted

    # No vowels
    assert vowels_count("bcdfg") == 0
    assert vowels_count("") == 0

    # Mixed case vowels
    assert vowels_count("AbEcIdE") == 5

    # Digits and punctuation
    assert vowels_count("a1e2i!") == 3
    assert vowels_count("!!!") == 0

    print("All tests passed.")

test_vowels_count()
